subject: Post-discovery: 60-90m technical deep dive with ML/Infra — proposed times
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: camila.reyes@redwood.com, dylan.brooks@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-discovery: 60-90m technical deep dive with ML/Infra — proposed times

Hi Samir / Aisha —

Thanks again for the great discovery earlier today. It was helpful to hear more about Acme’s deployment constraints and the production SLAs you’re targeting. As discussed, the next best step is a 60-90 minute technical deep dive with your ML and infra teams so we can:

- Walk through your current model serving architecture and pain points (inference latency, KV cache, autoscaling patterns)
- Share Redwood’s runtime architecture and quantization/ batching options that map to your goals
- Align on integration plan (VPC/private deployment vs. dedicated pools) and high-level timeline
- Identify any blocking security/compliance items to surface to Legal/SecOps early

Proposed 60-90m slots (all PT):
- Mon May 3: 10:00-11:30
- Tue May 4: 09:00-10:30
- Wed May 5: 13:00-14:30

Please confirm which of these works best and who from your side will join (ML lead / infra / security). I’m looping in Camila (ML solutions engineer) and Dylan (infra/ops lead) from our side — they’ll run the deep dive.

I’ve attached a short proposed agenda and an infra overview we usually share as a pre-read. If you prefer, feel free to pick a slot directly: https://calendly.com/redwood/marissa-demo-60

Thanks — look forward to locking this in.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Enterprise Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0122

- redwood-demo-agenda.pdf (1 page)
- infrastructure-overview.pptx (stub)

Marissa —

Appreciate the recap and the agenda. We’d like to include our ML lead and infra lead on the call: Elena Morales (elena.morales@acmehealth.com) and Aisha Khan (cc’d). Both are available for either Mon May 3 10:00-11:30 or Wed May 5 13:00-14:30 PT.

Two quick asks before we lock time:
1) Can your team include a short slide or overview of the requirements for a private deployment (networking/KMS)?
2) If possible, a couple minutes on how Redwood handles KV cache invalidation during model rollouts — our infra team will want to understand this.

If you can confirm availability for May 3, that’s our preferred slot.

Thanks,
